notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey there,
this is the first of many patches to improve the quality of the game.

Here's the patch notes:
[list]
[*] Increased the Visibility
[*] Buffed the Flashbang Item:
[list]
[*] Flash Duration: 2.9s -> 3.5s
[*] Flash Range: 13.3 -> 13.5
[/list]
[*] Buffed the Syringe Item:
[list]
[*] Duration: 2.3s -> 2.5s
[*] Speed Modifier: +30% -> +33%
[/list]
[*] Buffed the enemy
[/list] 

That's it for the first update! You can leave suggestions in the [url=https://discord.gg/efYGHaUP9e]discord [/url]or the discussion thread!

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Hey there,

CATACOMBS is finally released and available to play for free to everyone!

Make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/efYGHaUP9e]join the discord[/url] to give suggestions, feedback, report bugs and get updates!

Have a great day!
